name: Block
description: A placeable block: model, states, properties, inventory, energy, events and ore generation.

fields.label: Block base
fields.help: Start from a vanilla block shape and behavior. Empty is a plain custom block.

fields.label: Falls like sand
fields.help: Falls when nothing supports it. Not available with waterlogging.

fields.label: Sound and redstone set
fields.help: Material set used by doors, trapdoors, pressure plates and buttons.

fields.label: Falling leaf particle
fields.help: Particle dropping from leaves. Empty uses the default.

fields.label: Leaf particle chance
fields.help: Chance per display tick.

fields.label: Potted plant
fields.help: Plant shown inside the flower pot.

fields.label: Sign texture
fields.help: Entity texture of the sign.

fields.label: Hanging sign edit screen
fields.help: Background of the text editing screen.

fields.label: Main texture
fields.help: Texture used on every side unless a side texture below is set (bottom face for cubes).

fields.label: Top texture
fields.help: Optional.

fields.label: Left texture
fields.help: Optional.

fields.label: Front texture
fields.help: Optional.

fields.label: Right texture
fields.help: Optional.

fields.label: Back texture
fields.help: Optional.

fields.label: Model type
fields.help: Built-in shape or a custom model. Tinted variants are picked automatically when a tint is set.

fields.label: Model
fields.help: Built-in model name ("Normal", "Single texture", "Cross model", "Crop model", "Grass block", "Potted plant") or a custom model.

fields.label: Model textures
fields.help: Texture slots of the custom model. Map a slot to a project texture to draw it with that one instead of the model's own; an empty slot keeps the model's texture.

fields.label: Item texture
fields.help: Optional flat inventory icon instead of the 3D block.

fields.label: Item display transforms
fields.help: Optional JSON object for the block item model's "display" (gui, ground, fixed, thirdperson_righthand, ...), each with rotation, translation and scale.

fields.label: Particle texture
fields.help: Optional texture for break particles.

fields.label: Tooltip lines
fields.help: Extra tooltip lines under the name, one per row.

fields.label: Tooltip lines procedure
fields.help: Optional procedure that returns the tooltip lines instead of the fixed list.

fields.label: Rotation
fields.help: How the block faces when placed.

fields.label: Floor, wall and ceiling
fields.help: Also allow facing up and down (only for the horizontal rotation modes).

fields.label: Waterloggable
fields.help: Can hold water like stairs and slabs.

fields.label: Has transparency
fields.help: The block does not fill the full cube or has see-through pixels.

fields.label: Render layer
fields.help: How transparent pixels are drawn.

fields.label: Hide shared faces
fields.help: Faces touching the same block are not drawn, like glass.

fields.label: Show fluid overlay
fields.help: Show the water overlay texture instead of hiding faces next to water.

fields.label: Tint
fields.help: Color the texture with a biome color.

fields.label: Tint the item too
fields.help: Apply the same tint to the inventory item.

fields.label: Random offset
fields.help: Random position shift like flowers have.

fields.label: Ignore offset for boxes
fields.help: Keep the boxes in place even when the block is randomly offset.

fields.label: Walk through
fields.help: Entities can pass through the block.

fields.label: Boxes
fields.help: Outline and collision shape in pixels (0-16 per axis; further only for a block that spans several blocks).

fields.label: Subtract
fields.help: Cut this box out of the previous ones instead of adding it.

fields.label: Spans several blocks
fields.help: Boxes may reach past the block's own cell (below 0 or above 16): every cell they cover becomes part of the block. Placing it needs those cells free, breaking any part breaks the whole block and drops it once, and it turns with its facing. Only for blocks without a base that face nowhere or the four horizontal directions.

fields.label: Seatable
fields.help: Players sit on the block when they right-click it; sneaking stands them up, and breaking the block stands everyone up. No procedure or code is needed.

fields.label: Sit height
fields.help: Automatic: each seat sits on the top of the block's boxes under it (a slab-high box gives 0.5 blocks). Manual: each seat keeps its own height.

fields.label: Seats
fields.help: One row per player who can sit, in pixels from the north-west bottom corner (16 = one block) for the block facing north; a block with a facing turns its seats with it. Facing is in degrees from the block's front (0 looks out of the north face, 90 east). Click the preview to add a seat, drag a seat to move it.

fields.label: Height (Y)
fields.help: The seat surface; shown when the sit height is manual.

fields.label: Pose
fields.help: Sit: the player sits looking along the facing. Lie: the player lies on their back, head along the facing, the middle of the body on the point (a sofa's long side); no bed, no sleeping.

fields.label: Only with an empty hand
fields.help: A player holding something uses it on the block as usual (places a block, eats) instead of sitting.

fields.label: Stand up at
fields.help: Where a player stands when they get up. Front falls back to the top when the space in front is blocked.

fields.label: Properties
fields.help: Extra block state properties (logic, integer, number or text) with their default value.

fields.label: Default value
fields.help: Starting value, written as text (true/false, a number or one of the allowed values).

fields.label: Multipart format
fields.help: Write the block states as multipart instead of variants.

fields.label: State overrides
fields.help: Different model, textures or boxes for specific property values.

fields.label: When
fields.help: Property values this entry applies to.

fields.label: Main texture
fields.help: Texture used on every side unless a side texture below is set (bottom face for cubes).

fields.label: Top texture
fields.help: Optional.

fields.label: Left texture
fields.help: Optional.

fields.label: Front texture
fields.help: Optional.

fields.label: Right texture
fields.help: Optional.

fields.label: Back texture
fields.help: Optional.

fields.label: Subtract
fields.help: Cut this box out of the previous ones instead of adding it.

fields.label: Animations
fields.help: Animations played by a Java model block (needs the custom Java model type).

fields.label: Animation
fields.help: Animation id from the workspace.

fields.label: Play condition
fields.help: Optional; the animation plays while this returns true.

fields.label: Name
fields.help: Display name of the block.

fields.label: Hardness
fields.help: Time needed to break it. -1 makes it unbreakable.

fields.label: Unbreakable
fields.help: Cannot be broken in survival, like bedrock.

fields.label: Custom light opacity
fields.help: Set how much light the block blocks.

fields.label: Light opacity
fields.help: 0 lets all light through, 15 blocks it fully.

fields.label: Glowing texture
fields.help: Render at full brightness even in the dark.

fields.label: Post-process render
fields.help: Marks the block for the post-process render step, used for glowing blocks. Not available on Minecraft 26.x, which removed it.

fields.label: Replaceable
fields.help: Other blocks can be placed into it, like tall grass.

fields.label: Has an item
fields.help: Create an item form of the block.

fields.label: Creative tabs
fields.help: Creative inventory tabs that list this element. Tabs defined in this mod are offered as well.

fields.label: Custom sounds
fields.help: Pick each sound yourself instead of a vanilla sound set.

fields.label: Sound set
fields.help: Vanilla sound set for breaking, stepping and placing.

fields.label: Drop
fields.help: Item dropped instead of the block itself.

fields.label: Drop amount
fields.help: 0 drops nothing.

fields.label: Use a loot table
fields.help: Drops come from a loot table element instead of the settings above.

fields.label: Pick block item
fields.help: Item given on middle click in creative. Empty uses the block item.

fields.label: Needs correct tool
fields.help: Drops nothing unless mined with the right tool.

fields.label: Tool
fields.help: Tool type that mines it fastest.

fields.label: Minimum tier
fields.help: Lowest tool tier that can harvest it.

fields.label: Extra harvest condition
fields.help: Optional; return false to block harvesting.

fields.label: Material
fields.help: The block's material. It sets the default map color, whether lava ignites the block, and on Minecraft 1.16.5 how fast a pickaxe breaks it (only metal and stone are fast).

fields.label: Map color
fields.help: Color on filled maps.

fields.label: Note block sound
fields.help: Instrument when placed under a note block.

fields.label: Slipperiness
fields.help: 0.6 is normal, 0.98 is ice.

fields.label: Plants grow on it
fields.help: Saplings and flowers can be placed on top.

fields.label: Beacon beam color
fields.help: Tints a beacon beam passing through. Empty for none.

fields.label: Climbable
fields.help: Entities can climb it like a ladder.

fields.label: Enchanting power
fields.help: Bookshelf-style bonus for nearby enchanting tables.

fields.label: Mob pathfinding type
fields.help: How mobs treat the block when pathfinding.

fields.label: Stripped block
fields.help: Block it turns into when right clicked with an axe.

fields.label: Placement condition
fields.help: Optional; return false to forbid placing here.

fields.label: Tick rate
fields.help: Ticks between scheduled updates. 0 disables them.

fields.label: Random ticks
fields.help: Use random ticks like crops instead of a fixed rate.

fields.label: Redstone connects
fields.help: Redstone dust visually connects to it.

fields.label: Conducts redstone
fields.help: Passes redstone power through even if not a full block.

fields.label: Emits redstone
fields.help: Gives off redstone power.

fields.label: Power level procedure
fields.help: Optional procedure returning the power level.

fields.label: Light level
fields.help: Light emitted by the block.

fields.label: Light level procedure
fields.help: Optional procedure returning the light level per state.

fields.label: Bonemeal target
fields.help: Bonemeal can be used on it.

fields.label: Can use bonemeal
fields.help: Optional check whether bonemeal can be used now.

fields.label: Bonemeal succeeds
fields.help: Optional check whether a bonemeal use succeeds.

fields.label: On bonemeal success
fields.help: Runs when bonemeal succeeded.

fields.label: Flammability
fields.help: How fast it burns away.

fields.label: Fire spread speed
fields.help: How easily fire catches on it.

fields.label: Has inventory
fields.help: Give the block a block entity with item slots.

fields.label: GUI
fields.help: GUI element opened for this block. Empty for none.

fields.label: Comparator output
fields.help: Comparators read the fill level.

fields.label: Input slots
fields.help: Slot ids hoppers and pipes may insert into.

fields.label: Output slots
fields.help: Slot ids hoppers and pipes may extract from.

fields.label: Can extract
fields.help: Optional check for automated extraction.

fields.label: Can insert
fields.help: Optional check for automated insertion.

fields.label: Listens to vibrations
fields.help: Reacts to game events like a sculk sensor.

fields.label: Game events
fields.help: Game events it listens to (or one tag).

fields.label: Radius procedure
fields.help: Optional procedure returning the radius.

fields.label: Can receive vibration
fields.help: Optional filter for incoming vibrations.

fields.label: Stores energy
fields.help: Needs the block entity (inventory) to be enabled.

fields.label: Fluid tank
fields.help: Needs the block entity (inventory) to be enabled.

fields.label: Allowed fluids
fields.help: Fluids the tank accepts. Empty accepts all.

fields.label: Right clicked
fields.help: Runs when a player uses the block.

fields.label: Placed or added
fields.help: Runs when the block appears in the world.

fields.label: Update tick
fields.help: Scheduled or random tick.

fields.label: Client display tick
fields.help: Runs on the client now and then; for particles and sounds.

fields.label: Generate in the world
fields.help: Scatter the block through the terrain like an ore.

fields.label: Replaces
fields.help: Blocks (or tags) it can replace.

fields.label: Biomes
fields.help: Biomes (or one tag) where it generates. Empty means all.
